PINK_finger_velocity_drift.scope: direct cause of the observed failing value
PINK_finger_velocity_drift.evidence: The failing check occurs before solve/integration. Existing step-0 velocity points slightly downward, and the PINK finger target is overwritten before physics.

finger_included_in_arm_IK_unexpectedly.evidence: The full 9-joint URDF model, controlled_joint_names, project robot_joint_space, configuration, PostureTask and output all include both fingers.

input_q_already_over_limit.evidence: The error is raised by configuration.check_limits before build_ik, using q copied from estimated Isaac state.

integration_overshoot.evidence: No velocity or q_next exists because the pre-solve check aborts first.

joint_ordering_bug.evidence: Project asserts the Isaac 0..8 order; URDF/Pinocchio order and all saved telemetry match it; index 8 is consistently finger2.

arm_gripper_merge_bug.evidence: The final selected-index Articulation write overwrites finger targets with float32 0.04 after the full PINK write.

dtype_precision.evidence: The observed excess is about 401.76 float32 ULP and 200.88 project tolerances. PINK promotes the measured float32 value to float64 and already allows 1e-6.

isaac_runtime_joint_state_already_above_.evidence: The value reported from PINK q can only come from robot.get_dof_positions on that forward call. Older telemetry also records actual finger2 positions slightly above the final 0.04 target.

PINK_strict_internal_configuration_check.evidence: Configuration.check_limits uses q > upper + 1e-6 before QP solve; the observed excess is 1.49667263030923e-6.

position_drive_tracking_overshoot_at_har.evidence: The final target is exactly the float32 upper limit, while saved actual positions sometimes exceed it. Exact mid-descent drive state/stiffness response was not logged.

finger_unit_labeling_bug.evidence: Finger joints are prismatic in the URDF, so their values are meters; several project telemetry field names use a generic _rad suffix.

root_cause: PINK receives an already-over-limit Isaac finger2 current state because the project includes the independently controlled gripper in the arm IK configuration. PINK's pre-solve 1e-6 limit check rejects it before producing a velocity.
